summary: Tested the tiered website discovery feature on backend and frontend; there are no Serper or Brave keys. Backend: 13/13 read-only checks passed before mutation. (1) The Burwood Cannings lookup was needs_review with candidate canningsfreerangebutchers.com.au -> final_url canningsbutchers.com.au/, score 55, source existing_scout_record, website_status website_unverified and email_status needs_review. (2) integrations/status: serper and brave configured=false, plus website_discovery stats. (3) Both test endpoints return ok:false 'API key not set'. (4) recheck returns 400 'Add a Serper or Brave search key first'. (5) confirm returns 400 for facebook.com and for 'not a url', '', 'https://nodot' and 'ftp//x'. (6) A request without a token returns 401/403, and an unknown business returns 404. Mutating flow on Burwood only: reject -> rejected_by_user (rejected_domains=[canningsfreerangebutchers.com.au]); search again -> search_requested and refresh_requested; the worker re-ran within about 5s. The lookup did NOT return to needs_review: it became search_unavailable / website_not_verified because the rejected domain stays excluded. Confirm through the UI's manual input with https://canningsbutchers.com.au -> website set, website_source manual_confirmation, confidence 100, refresh_requested; the worker then gave research_status assessed and website_status website_exists, and found contact sam@canningsbutchers.com.au. Frontend: the Website search tab opens by default for website_unverified; the panel, status badge, candidate card (55/100 and signals), confirm, manual input/save (disabled when empty), search again and reject-all are all present. An invalid manual URL shows an error toast. After confirm, detail-website-link and detail-website-source ('confirmed by you · confidence 100') show. The Prospects filter has the 3 new options, and filtering to website_unverified works. On Integrations, the Serper and Brave cards show 'Setup Required', the recheck button is disabled and the cost text reads '0 searches · about US$0.00'. Mobile at 390px has no horizontal overflow, but the tab bar overlaps the content. No JS page errors.

minor.issue: The review expected the lookup to return to needs_review from existing data. In fact rejected_domains persists, so tier 1 skips canningsfreerangebutchers.com.au and the result is search_unavailable / website_not_verified. This is arguably correct, since it respects the user's rejection. If 'Search again' should reconsider rejected candidates, clear rejected_domains in search_website_again or pass force. Decide which behaviour you want and make the UI copy match.

research_status='assessed' is written BEFORE draft generation and the email_status update. My test-file creation under /app/backend/tests triggered a uvicorn reload while the worker was in 'Generating personalised email'. Burwood is now left with website_status website_exists, research_status assessed, no draft and a STALE email_status 'needs_review'. The worker never retries it. Fix: set the email_status for the email stage first, or mark research as assessed only after the draft step finishes, or run a startup sweep for this state. The USER or main agent should click Reassess on Burwood to produce the normal draft. Note that sending.test_mode is currently FALSE; the only campaign is autonomous but 'completed'.

ui_bugs.issue: The 7 tab triggers wrap onto 3 lines but the TabsList keeps a fixed height. 'Visabal Brief / Email / Contacts / Outreach / History' spill over the 'Website discovery' card heading. Use h-auto with flex-wrap, or overflow-x-auto with a horizontal scroll.

issues: The Website tab opens by default only for website_unverified. Consider opening it for website_not_verified too, since that status is also actionable.
After a manual confirm, the lookup header still reads 'Searched … · existing data · confidence 100'. Show 'Confirmed by you <date>' instead.
The business-details badge shows the stale 'Website Not Verified' until reassessment finishes. This is acceptable, but a 'reassessing' hint would help.
Native <select> elements are still used for the filters (carried over).

action_items: Burwood Cannings: click Reassess (or set research_status refresh_requested) so a draft or the correct email_status is produced. It is currently stale at needs_review because a reload interrupted the assessment.
Make assess_business resilient to interruption between 'assessed' and the draft/email_status step
Decide whether 'Search again' after a reject should reconsider rejected domains (currently it does not, so the result is website_not_verified)
Fix the TabsList overlap at mobile 390px on the prospect detail page
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is about 1320 lines; split it into routers (website discovery endpoints could live in their own module)
find_website: `cached = prev or <key lookup>`. When this business's own lookup exists but is stale or expired, the cross-business cache by key is never consulted.
confirm_website validation is regex-only. 'https://nodot' is rejected (good), but URLs are not normalised: trailing slashes and the www./non-www difference can create different stored website values.
Writing any .py file under /app/backend (including tests) reloads uvicorn and kills in-flight worker jobs. Consider excluding tests/ from --reload-dir.

success_rate.backend: 13/13 read-only checks passed before mutation, plus the reject/search/confirm flow. 1 expectation deviated (search again -> website_not_verified, not needs_review). The final email_status is stale because of an interrupted run.
